package_info.why_malicious: The package contains code that reads sensitive local files from browsers and the Discord application, then exfiltrates their contents to an external Discord webhook, resulting in credential and privacy compromise.

execution_context.file_location: main JavaScript file of the fallguys package

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code reads LevelDB files from browser and Discord application directories, then sends their contents via HTTPS POST to a Discord webhook, resulting in exfiltration of sensitive user data.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Accessing browser and Discord local storage files and exfiltrating their contents to an external webhook is a clear sign of credential theft and privacy violation.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A legitimate npm package for a game API should not access or transmit local browser or Discord storage files.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate backup or migration tools may access browser data, but only with explicit user consent and never exfiltrate to third-party webhooks.
key_indicators: Access to browser and Discord LevelDB files
Use of HTTPS POST to Discord webhook
No user interaction or consent for file access or exfiltration

attack_chain.action: Upon importing or executing the fallguys package, the malicious code is triggered.
attack_chain.leads_to: Sensitive files are accessed and prepared for exfiltration.

attack_chain.action: The code reads LevelDB files from Chrome, Opera, Yandex, Brave, and Discord local storage directories.
attack_chain.leads_to: Collected data is ready for transmission.

attack_chain.action: The contents of these files are sent via HTTPS POST to a hardcoded Discord webhook.
attack_chain.leads_to: Exfiltrated data is available to the attacker.

behavioral_signatures: Node.js packages accessing browser or Discord LevelDB files
Automated HTTPS POST requests to Discord webhooks
File access patterns targeting browser and Discord storage directories
network_indicators: discord.com/api/webhooks/* (unexpected POST requests from non-Discord clients)
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for npm packages that access browser or Discord LevelDB files and initiate outbound HTTPS POST requests to Discord webhooks. Flag any package that reads these files without explicit user action or consent, especially if network exfiltration is involved. Review package contents for hardcoded references to Discord webhook URLs and suspicious file access patterns.
